title: pm-dispatch(contract-review): narrow the at-tier full review to the spec/skills/ADR diff plus its implementing code, re-review only after must-fix or should-fix, and adopt a card thread's at-tier record instead of reviewing it twice
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dMH5MgvNqv8hYSeWv

Filing gate: ③ a task ordered directly by the project owner, quoted verbatim below.
Reader: `domain:skills` seat, next PR on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (〈复核归属与资格〉), the policy line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (ACCEPT 之后的路径分叉, line 190 at `21c1f748`), and the brief and template in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (`contractReviewBriefLines`, `--template`) with their self-tests.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "pm-dispatch contract-review in:title" → 29 hits, nearest #25765 (added the full review ④), #26527 (④ names the three surfaces), #27062, #29242, #29667, #26667 (who reviews, all closed); "pm-dispatch review in:title is:open" → 0; "nit delta review in:title" → 0; "full review scope in:title" → 0. None narrows the full review's scope or its re-review trigger.

## The order

田騏 (`marchtian`), 2026-11-07, project thread, verbatim and untranslated:

> 凡是改 spec、skills 或 ADR 的卡都要做一轮 Fable 全量复核，是复核所有代码吗？这个合理吗？还是只需要复核   spec、skills 或 ADR  的聂荣 (16:06:42Z)

The proposal put to the owner in reply (the project coordinator's words, verbatim):

> 建议改成：
> - Fable 只复核 spec、skills、ADR 的改动，加上直接实现这份契约的代码。PR 里其他的代码改动（测试、无关模块、changeset 等）由 Opus 自审。
> - 修完之后的增量复核只在出现过 must-fix 或 should-fix 时才做，只有 nit 就不再复核。
> - 席位的契约复核已经由开发线程的 Fable 覆盖到的部分，就不重复看了。

The owner's answer: 「同意立卡」 (16:07:11Z), then 「通知席位并立skills卡」 (16:07:22Z). Goal stated with the proposal: cut token use.

Read as (the filer's reading, for the implementing seat to confirm):
- "Fable" = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; "Opus" = `TIER_DEFAULT`. ⛔ The rule text spells the constants, never a model id.
- 「直接实现这份契约的代码」 = files in the PR's own diff whose hunks implement or enforce a `hits` change: the gate that enforces a rule, the code a jsdoc or schema line describes, the validator a skill teaches. Code outside the diff stays "read, not reviewed".

## Why

The written rule is already narrower than practice. `contract-review.md` scopes the at-tier record to `reviewFace` `hits` plus the files those hunks claim about, and hands the rest to the lane seat at `TIER_DEFAULT`. But the project's standing instruction to card threads (2026-10-25, from #25765) reads "any spec/skills/ADR change needs a complete review at the top tier before merge", so dev threads have been running an at-tier review of the WHOLE PR, and then the seat runs its own at-tier contract review of the same head. Two reviews at the top tier, one of them over tests, unrelated modules and changesets.

The part of the full review that earns its cost is the contract-vs-code check. Example: #31094, where the review held the jsdoc sentence by sentence against the write-gate code. Today's brief says the cited code is "READ to judge them, never reviewed", so a mismatch between the contract and the code shipped in the same PR has no named owner. This card names it, and drops the rest.

## What to change

1. **Scope of ④ (and the at-tier record).** At-tier scope = the `hits` files plus the diff's own files that directly implement or enforce them, judged for contract-vs-code agreement. Everything else in the diff (tests, unrelated modules, lockfiles, generated output, changesets) is the lane seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT, unchanged. Edit:
   - `contract-review.md`: the scope line ("混合 diff 的达档复核范围 = …") and the ④ line ("被引代码读而不审"): implementing code inside the diff is reviewed for agreement with the contract; code outside the diff stays read-only.
   - `record-recognisers.mjs` `contractReviewBriefLines`: the two scope branches and the ④ judge line say the same; the record's `Scope:` line names the implementing files apart from `hits`.
   - The narrowing face (whole-diff floor, ruling record 6203713500 letter B; ④ shape, ruling record 6442046166 letter A) is a maintainer ruling. ⛔ This card does not change it. State in the PR whether it already matches the order, and leave it unchanged if it does not.
2. **Re-review trigger.** A delta review happens only when the last at-tier round named a must-fix or a should-fix. A round with only nits (or no findings) is final.
   - `contract-review.md` line 42 ("只落发现的 commit 由同一复核者 delta 复核;无 must-fix 即止") is rewritten to say this.
   - The brief's ④ line gains a third severity: nit = no effect on correctness or the contract. The record grades each finding must-fix / should-fix / nit.
   - ⚠ Constraint the PR must solve: the landing check wants an at-tier PASS on the CURRENT head, and the queue guard (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`) carries a record forward only over certified pure-regeneration or prose-only hops. If a nit is fixed in code after a PASS, the head moves and the record no longer covers it. Recommended: nits are fixed only in prose-only commits (already carried forward), or left as accepted deviations in the seat's ACCEPT, or moved to a follow-up. That avoids any gate-code change. Adding a new carry-forward hop kind to the guard is the alternative; if the PR does that, it says why.
3. **No second at-tier review of the same scope.** An at-tier record posted by a card thread's isolated sub-agent counts as the head's record when all of these hold: it is the full `## Contract review` record from `--template`, its brief came from `--brief-template` (fed the card, the PR and the check-runs, ⛔ not the drafter's conclusions), it was posted on the current head, and its `Scope:` line covers the floor. The seat reads that record and checks its scope and independence lines. It runs at tier only over what the `Scope:` line leaves out. ⛔ It does not re-run the covered scope. Edit:
   - `contract-review.md`: the "复核记录 = …" and "子代理记采纳它的席位" lines (who adopts a card-thread sub-agent's record).
   - `SKILL.md` line 190 ("席未达档起隔离达档复核"): the seat starts its own at-tier review only for scope the record on the head does not already cover.
   - `references/dispatch-runbook.md` card-thread section (line 137, 「席位留…契约复核…」) and `references/coordinator.md` 〈四〉: the card thread's at-tier review is the `--brief-template` record, posted on the PR, and the seat's job is to adopt it or fill the gap.
4. **Policy text.** The SKILL.md passage carries the order as one clause in the same edit, and `contract-review.md` stays its detail. Per `lanes/skills.md`, ask who reads each new line. Shrink-only ratchets apply.

## Boundary

- `.claude/**` is a governed surface (Tier S). This card changes the review rules themselves, so its own PR is reviewed under the NEW scope: at tier over the rule text plus the brief code that implements it (`record-recognisers.mjs`). Whether the owner's 「同意立卡」 is enough to land it, or a further word is owed, is the director's and the skills seat's call. ⛔ This card does not decide it.
- Outside the repo: the project coordinator's own standing instruction to card threads (the 2026-10-25 rule) is updated by the coordinator now, from the owner's approval. It does not wait for this PR.
- Not in scope: re-reviewing PRs that already merged; the drafting tier rules in `execution-duties.md` (who drafts at which tier, #25729, #29741).
